jobs.description:

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) (f/m/d) for Field Services, you will influence supplier decisions and work with suppliers to develop them in alignment with Siemens Energy's needs for capacity, capability, and cost. Typical services include Scaffolding, Assemblies, Machining, Blasting, Welding, NDT, Mechanical and Electrical Installation, Commissioning, and Site Management. As part of a diverse team of professionals, you will leverage both your expertise and that of your team to ensure that our supply chain meets the highest quality standards.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Be the point of contact for the Field Service Global Commodity Manager in developing procurement strategies and project planning, supplier identification, capability assessment audits, and driving standards in alignment with codes and EHS requirements
* Lead a distributed team of Supplier Quality Engineers, fostering an environment of collaborative learning and training
* Support cross-functional teams in Execution Units with Product and Process Qualification (PPQ) for Field Service approvals, including planning, tracking, and reporting on project milestones, budget, and resource needs
* Act as a commodity expert in developing strategic suppliers and supporting critical technical issues by building and owning a commodity/technology network

* Degree or equivalent experience in electrical/mechanical engineering or a related field
* Longstanding professional experience in an area of Field Service, supplier quality management, procurement and EHS
* Experience performing supplier qualification, technical supplier assessment & development to provide a global quality-assured and cost-effective supply base
* Experience in leading projects and running virtual multi-functional teams in an international environment

In this role, you are a Senior Performance Controller & Digital Controlling Analyst for our Execution Unit Gas Services Distributed and act as a close finance partner to the operational management. * Act as the primary Performance Controlling contact for one Execution Unit, partnering closely with Execution Unit management

* Prepare and deliver monthly performance reports, forecasts, ad-hoc analyses and management presentations with a strong focus on KPIs, drivers and deviations

* Continuously improve controlling, reporting and management review processes, driving standardization, efficiency and quality
* Drive digitalization and automation initiatives (e.g. Power BI, data models, reporting logic), while collaborating closely with Finance colleagues across Execution Units and central functions

* Long-term experience in Performance Controlling and/or operational Finance, ideally in an industrial or project-based environment, with strong exposure to planning, forecasting and actuals

* Strong digital and analytical mindset with a clear interest in data-driven finance and digital transformation

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Head of Service Operations Controlling, you will have full responsibility for all controlling and reporting activities related to Europe and Africa Service Operations. 
This includes financial planning, forecasting, actual reporting, and analysis for multiple countries in Europe and Africa. You will directly lead a team of employees in Germany and coordinate with local business partner in the countries to ensure accurate and timely reporting & controlling. 
In this position you are responsible to steer the operational day-to-day controlling activities for field service & tooling cost centers. You will act as a business partner to Service Operations leadership, providing in-depth financial analysis, preparing scenario models for strategic decisions, and assessing risks for ongoing and new projects. You will also drive the implementation of process standardization, automation, and digitalization initiatives (including AI).

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Team Leadership & Development: Manage a team of up to 8 employees in Germany and a network of local business partner in several countries. Define Roles & Responsibilities set clear performance targets, conduct regular 1:1s, organize team workshops, and oversee talent development.
* Financials Planning, Forecast and actual reporting of Order Entry, Revenue, Revenue Margin and Free Cash Flow for Service Operations internal business with New Unit, On-shore Projects and other Business Areas
* Financial Planning, Reporting & Analysis: Own the annual budget process, prepare monthly forecast and actual reporting for Service Operations cost centers, Headcount and Capex. Consolidate data from all countries, analyze cost variances, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare and present management reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses for senior leadership.
* Ensure accurate tracking and operational management of all cost centers, collaborate with Service Operations Management and EU&AF Business Controlling
* Process Optimization & Digitalization: Map and standardize controlling processes across countries. Identify manual tasks and drive automation using SAP enhancements, RPA bots, and Power BI dashboards. Lead digitalization projects, including AI implementation for predictive analytics and reporting.
* Compliance & Internal Controls: Implement and monitor internal controls to ensure compliance with company policies, SOX requirements, and local regulations.

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a comparable field, or equivalent qualification (e.g., Siemens commercial apprenticeship combined with extensive professional experience), with long-term, in-depth experience in Business Controlling or Finance, particularly in closing, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Experience in Finance / BC, Sales or Project Management in Gas Services or with one of the Gas Services Execution Units Central or Distributed is preferred with basic understanding of the underlying business models and technical Siemens Energy products and solutions
* Proven leadership experience and ability to lead teams effectively in a matrix organization

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Head of Product Excellence (f/m/d) for the Steam Turbine and Generator (STG) business no day will look the same. The focus of the team is on collecting and reporting non-conformance data from across all the STG business segments as well as managing the processes for continuous improvement efforts.  Week-to-week, the rhythm changes focus from reporting the figures to evaluation of the results and ensuring the improvement activities are making progress. There are additional tasks that include Document Management, 3i, PCM, auditing and local support for different tasks where the employees are sitting.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Governance for Non-Conformance Cost (NCC) reporting for the STG business. This includes the NCC process, monthly reporting and visualization. Support the extended STG organization for all service lines and functions with information on next steps to help them meet the “not to exceed” targets.
* Governance for the CAPA (Corrective Action and Preventative Action) process. This includes the process, tools and training to ensure CAPA are being executed efficiently and effectively. KPI’s are then tracked by the EQS PE team for progress and reporting.
* Facilitate monthly Quality Ambassador meetings to involve the cross-functional organization with CAPA quality and lessons learned throughout the business
* Manage a diverse team of nine quality professionals who support Non-Conformance Management across five countries
* Oversee the document management system (BIC Cloud/SEPH) and ensure compliance with the SE requirements
* Support the SAP S4Energy transition as Capability Lead for STG EQS.  This responsibility requires working knowledge of the business processes and learning how the new SAP system will work.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in quality management or similar field
* Multiple years of experience in Quality Management or relevant field with proven capabilities for root cause analysis methods, basic statistical analysis tools and interpretation of results
* Knowledge of the ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 Integrated Management System preferred
* Working knowledge of SAP and MS Office Suite; AI Copilot a plus
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written; fluency in English

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.employer_name: Syddansk Universitet
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

• 
General power electronics and its reliability

• 
Multimaterial additive manufacturing

• 
Printed electronics

• 
Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

• 
Surface and interface engineering

• 
Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

• 
Materials for power electronics

• 
Energy-device manufacturing

• 
Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

• 
An outstanding research and publication track record 

• 
Experience with industrial collaboration

• 
Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

• 
Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

• 
Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

• 
Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

• 
Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

• 
Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

• 
Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

• 
Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

• 
Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

• 
Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

• 
Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Ideas for research and development activities.

• 
Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position. 

• 
Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
